LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: Public, non-PII student ranking entry updated in real-time after quiz completions and profile edits.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID matching the document ID.

weeklyPoints.description: Points earned during the ISO week specified by weekKey.

weekKey.description: ISO week identifier in YYYY-Www format (e.g., 2026-W47).

perfectQuizCount.description: Number of quizzes completed with 100% accuracy.

activeMultiplier.description: Currently active point multiplier potion value (1 to 1,000,000).

publicVisible.description: Visibility flag required to be true for authenticated leaderboard queries.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last score or profile update.

/leaderboard/{userId}.description: Real-time Global and Weekly student leaderboard entries keyed by authenticated userId.
